title: VSCode's SSH Agent Is Bananas (2025)
summary: A technical blog post from Fly.io exploring the quirky and problematic behavior of VSCode's SSH agent implementation, particularly when dealing with remote development workflows. The article uses real-world debugging experiences to highlight unexpected edge cases that confuse developers.
problem_solved: Explains and documents the confusing behavior of VSCode's SSH agent that leads to unexpected authentication or connection issues during remote development.
why_valuable: Helps developers understand and troubleshoot SSH-related issues in VSCode's remote development extension, which is critical for cloud-based development workflows.
